coverage: Four provinces, Islamabad Capital Territory, and the Pakistan-administered territories of Azad Jammu and Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan. FATA is merged with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. WFP/OCHA HDX COD-AB first-level geometry, valid 9 September 2022 and reviewed 27 September 2024, under CC BY 3.0 IGO. The still-current seven first-level units are verified against PBS; outdated district and tehsil layers are not exposed. Kashmir polygons describe administration, not sovereignty; no source claims are expanded into India-administered areas. Shared Chinese border edges follow the atlas China geometry. The regular India frontier follows one continuous existing India outline, preserving every river bend. Kashmir control and claim coverage remains source-defined. Lakes are removed from land fills while administrative boundaries continue across water. Population is the 2023 census; PBS totals for four provinces and ICT exclude AJK/GB, whose totals are separately sourced from their official 2025 statistical publications.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.

indiaFrontier.detail: Only the continuous regular frontier arc is reused; the retained input SHA-256 is recorded in context-reconciliation.json.

pakistanIndiaReconciliation.policy: The northern background silhouette follows the existing Pakistan disputed-area display edge through Kashmir and Siachen to the actual Chinese seam; it is drawn as one continuous path, with nearby duplicate claim strokes hidden in Pakistan view. Detailed India claim coverage is unchanged. One continuous regular shared border follows the retained detailed India outline and is drawn once per view. Existing Kashmir claim/control coverage is preserved. Claim visibility uses political coverage including inland water; Mangla and Tarbela are excluded from all country and fallback land fills. Pakistan administrative boundaries retain their full political paths across water.

chinaFrontierReconciliation.policy: Continuous displayed China outline shared by Pakistan land and the western India background. Existing detailed India claim geometry and source population figures remain intact. Disputed-area strokes keep their claim metadata and India-view alternatives. Pakistan source Siachen diagonal extent is retained and meets one common projected China junction.
